translation: Target is the proposition that there is no derivation of the formula fls from the empty set of hypotheses. No hypothesis is available, but a derivation may use as an axiom any Def11 formula prefixed by zero or more universal quantifiers, or K applied once to any such prefixed formula. The only inference rule is modus ponens: from imp φ ψ and φ, infer ψ. The definition states this nonderivability condition; it does not prove it or require nonderivability from any nonempty set of hypotheses.
